## 安裝已發布套件

請從 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scnsim/releases/tag/v1.0.0a3) 安裝 CPython 3.12 預建套件（wheel），並在空資料夾中初始化專案：

{{< include ../../_generated/canonical-code/examples/engineer/setup.qmd/block-001.qmd >}}

依作業系統與架構選擇對應命令：

<details>
<summary>Windows x86_64（AMD64）</summary>

{{< include ../../_generated/canonical-code/examples/engineer/setup.qmd/block-002.qmd >}}

</details>

<details>
<summary>macOS arm64</summary>

{{< include ../../_generated/canonical-code/examples/engineer/setup.qmd/block-003.qmd >}}

</details>

<details>
<summary>Linux x86_64</summary>

{{< include ../../_generated/canonical-code/examples/engineer/setup.qmd/block-004.qmd >}}

</details>

| Python | 作業系統與架構 | 預建套件 |
|---|---|---|
| CPython 3.12 | Windows x86_64（AMD64） | [Release 預建套件](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scnsim/releases/download/v1.0.0a3/scnsim-1.0.0a3-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl) |
| CPython 3.12 | macOS arm64（Apple Silicon） | [Release 預建套件](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scnsim/releases/download/v1.0.0a3/scnsim-1.0.0a3-cp312-cp312-macosx_12_0_arm64.whl) |
| CPython 3.12 | Linux x86_64 | [Release 預建套件](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scnsim/releases/download/v1.0.0a3/scnsim-1.0.0a3-cp312-cp312-manylinux1_x86_64.manylinux_2_28_x86_64.manylinux_2_5_x86_64.whl) |

這些預建套件不需要 C++ 編譯器。其他 Python 版本或平台請依[貢獻指南的來源建置說明](../../docs/contribute.qmd#build-from-source)操作。

## 選用 Jupyter 環境

若要執行 Notebook，才將 Jupyter 加入專案：

{{< include ../../_generated/canonical-code/examples/engineer/setup.qmd/block-005.qmd >}}

請從包含 `examples.engineer.diagram_layouts` 輔助程式的完整來源檢出使用課程 Notebook。檢出與建置方式請參閱[貢獻指南](../../docs/contribute.qmd)。
